title: a16z Podcast: Damage-free Genome Editing -- Next in CRISPR

reader_summary.headline: Where are we in the wave of the genome engineering "developer community" building on top of CRISPR with a constantly growing suite of programmable functionalities?.
reader_summary.overview: Where are we in the wave of the genome engineering "developer community" building on top of CRISPR with a constantly growing suite of programmable functionalities? a16z bio general partner Jorge Conde and bio deal team partner Andy Tran chat with Hanne Tidnam about these trends -- and these two papers -- in this short internal hallway-style conversation. a16z and its affiliates may maintain investments in the companies discussed.
